summary: It is unusually easy to make the call, send the message, or act on a decision you have been sitting on once you stop demanding a perfect plan.
body: It is unusually easy to make the call, send the message, or act on a decision you have been sitting on once you stop demanding a perfect plan. When the Sun sextiles Mars, core vitality and initiative cooperate, giving you a clean opening to move before overthinking turns a simple task back into a massive project. Stop endlessly revising the strategy and spend this momentum on immediate execution. If you already know the correct move, stop waiting for consensus and simply clear the bottleneck yourself.
